title: David Copperfield
author: Charles Dickens
summary: David narrates his own life, from an unhappy childhood under a cruel stepfather through hard work in London and the people who shape him, until he becomes a writer. It is told in a warm, comic, often sad voice.
readIf: you want a huge, character-filled Dickens novel that feels like spending time with a very long, loving story.
skipIf: you want a tight plot, since it is episodic and wanders.

pairings.reason: A tighter, darker Dickens novel on a similar theme of a boy rising in the world.
A faster, more melodramatic Dickens orphan story.
A lighter, more cheerful orphan story with a similar affection for eccentric characters.
